Repository: https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/SkinTokens
Reviewed upstream commit: 273b691d35989d71cd17ff2895fdc735097b92d1 (2026-05-12)

This Skill ZIP contains **original adapter code only**, not a cloned SkinTokens
source tree, pretrained weights or NVIDIA/CUDA runtime. Use the
`get_official_skintokens_source.sh` helper to clone actual pinned upstream source
on a network-enabled workstation, and follow its README for GPU inference.

SkinTokens upstream is MIT licensed; keep its copyright and license whenever
redistributing upstream code or files. Blender and PyMeshLab upstream
GPL-3.0 licensing requirements still apply to their separately installed software.
